name: overview-page
title: Overview page
description: Overview as it ships, a page composition: the setup line, the greeting and how many documents agents search beside the API key's window in the double rule, Queries beside Credits, the largest namespaces. The console's frame and page head come with it.
use_for: The console's home for a team that is running. Start a console page from ConsoleFrame and ConsolePage.
never: A search box on the overview: agents search, people check
More than one dark button: Create API key is the page's one
Loading as an empty page: rows keep their layout while they load
source: conare-web app/components/console/Home.vue (take 7, lead 5), app/components/console/platform/*.vue, app/layouts/console.vue, app/components/console/Page.vue, app/assets/css/platform.css, console2.css (.v2-home-lead, .v2-stats, .v2-meter, .v2-setupline)
body:
`ConsoleFrame` is the console's layout: the Sidebar (a drawer under 768px), the TopBar with the trail and the page
under it; `head` takes the workspace switcher and `foot` the account menu. `ConsolePage` is every other page's head:
the title (Faculty Glyphic, or mono for an identifier), its actions on the right, the body in 24px steps.

The greeting is `highlight-text` (its letters settle from faint red to ink, once); the documents line counts up the
first time in a session (`count`); the key window is the website's product window (`VizWindow`, as `step-viz` and the
other viz items use it) over the grain and a sheet of cells (`cell-burst`), playing again every 9 seconds while the
tab shows. `OverviewQueries` draws its charts with `chart`: `BarChart` for queries per day, `LineChart` for the last
24 hours' latency (`latency` is its series, p50 and p95).

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Activity, Atom, CreditCard, Gauge, House, KeyRound, Layers, Network, Settings, SquareTerminal } from 'lucide-vue-next'
import ConsoleFrame from '@/components/product/ConsoleFrame.vue'
import OverviewPage from '@/components/product/OverviewPage.vue'
// Overview as it ships, in the console's frame, on sample data: setup still open, Queries for the last 90 days,
// credits and the largest namespaces. Wire the events to your own routes.
const groups = [
  { label: 'Platform', links: [{ label: 'Overview', icon: House, active: true }, { label: 'Namespaces', icon: Layers, status: '6' }, { label: 'Sources', icon: Network, status: '1 failed', alert: true }, { label: 'Agents', icon: SquareTerminal }, { label: 'Custom models', icon: Atom }] },
  { label: 'Manage', links: [{ label: 'API keys', icon: KeyRound, status: '3' }, { label: 'Performance', icon: Gauge }, { label: 'Usage', icon: Activity }, { label: 'Billing', icon: CreditCard }, { label: 'Settings', icon: Settings }] },
]
// 90 days ending on Nov 4, a weekday rhythm with a slow climb.
const end = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 4)
const days = Array.from({ length: 90 }, (_, i) => {
  const at = new Date(end - (89 - i) * 86400000)
  const weekend = at.getUTCDay() === 0 || at.getUTCDay() === 6
  return { day: at.toISOString().slice(0, 10), value: Math.round((weekend ? 1800 : 5200) + i * 42 + ((i * 37) % 11) * 140) }
})
const thisMonth = days.filter(d => d.day.startsWith('2026-11')).reduce((a, d) => a + d.value, 0)
// The last 24 hours, every 30 minutes: p50 and p95.
const half = (i: number) => end - (47 - i) * 1800000
const latency = [
  { label: 'p50', points: Array.from({ length: 48 }, (_, i) => ({ t: half(i), v: 140 + ((i * 29) % 17) * 6 + (i % 12 === 5 ? 90 : 0) })) },
  { label: 'p95', points: Array.from({ length: 48 }, (_, i) => ({ t: half(i), v: 260 + ((i * 31) % 13) * 8 + (i % 12 === 5 ? 120 : 0) })) },
]
const namespaces = [
  { name: 'contracts', documents: 412830, health: 'ready' as const, synced: '2 min ago', lastUsed: '2 min ago' },
  { name: 'support', documents: 2184920, health: 'syncing' as const, lastUsed: '1 min ago' },
  { name: 'wiki', documents: 96410, health: 'ready' as const, synced: '12 min ago', lastUsed: '1 h ago' },
  { name: 'crm', documents: 52660, health: 'error' as const, lastUsed: 'yesterday' },
  { name: 'engineering', documents: 31902, health: 'api' as const, lastUsed: '3 days ago' },
  { name: 'research', documents: 7385, health: 'api' as const },
]
</script>

<template>
  <ConsoleFrame :groups="groups" :crumbs="[{ label: 'Overview' }]">
    <OverviewPage
      greeting="Good afternoon"
      :documents="2786122"
      :setup="{ done: 3, total: 4 }"
      :queries="{ thisMonth, p50: 182, p95: 296, days, latency }"
      :credits="{ left: 412.6, total: 500, spenders: [{ name: 'support', cost: 54.2, share: 0.62 }, { name: 'contracts', cost: 21.85, share: 0.25 }, { name: 'wiki', cost: 0.4, share: 0.004 }] }"
      :namespaces="namespaces"
    />
  </ConsoleFrame>
</template>
